services.desc: The Paterson Museum’s main gallery contains a variety of permanent exhibitions dedicated to recounting many important stories of Paterson’s past. Click on the pages below to learn more about our permanent exhibitions. From the Panama Canal to the Rogers Locomotive Works: A History of the Paterson Museum The Paterson Museum acquires and preserves the cultural, technological and geological history of our City. services.name: Event Rentals
services.desc: The Paterson Museum offers a unique setting that will make your event very special. Whether you plan to welcome a few dozen guests or a one hundred, the museum has several options to choose from and so much more. The Hannah Gallery is our primary rental space. Its adaptable space provides the perfect setting for standing receptions, formal seated dinners or presentations. The room can seat up to 100 depending on exhibit and table configuration. The Paterson Museum is available for both private functions and non-profit use.
